description_en: Queries the file details of a backup data upload task for an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS SQL Server备份数据上云任务的文件详情
name: DescribeOssDownloads

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the migration task. You can call the DescribeMigrateTasks operation to query the migration task ID
parameters.help_zh: 迁移任务的ID，可通过DescribeMigrateTasks接口查询
parameters.name: migrate_task_id

items.description_en: The details of the imported file

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup type. Valid values:
Database: full backup file
Differential_Database: incremental backup file
Transaction_Log: log backup file
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份类型，取值：
Database：全量备份文件
Differential_Database：增量备份文件
Transaction_Log：日志备份文件

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the backup file was created in the download list. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 备份文件在下载列表中的创建时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

EndTime.description_en: The end time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

FileName.description_en: The name of the backup file in OSS

FileSize.description_en: The size of the backup file. Unit: MB

IsAvailable.description_en: Indicates whether the file is available. Valid values: True | False

Status.description_en:
The file status. Valid values:
NoStart: Not started.
Downloading: Downloading.
Finished: Download completed.
DownloadFailed: Download failed.
VerifyFailed: MD5 verification failed.
Deleted: Deleted.
DeleteFailed: Deletion failed.
CheckSuccess: Check succeeded.
CheckFailed: Check failed.
Restoring: Restoring.
Restored: Restoration succeeded.
RestoreFailed: Restoration failed
Status.description_zh:
文件状态，取值：
NoStart：未开始
Downloading：下载中
Finished：下载完成
DownloadFailed：下载失败
VerifyFailed：MD5校验失败
Deleted：已删除
DeleteFailed：删除失败
CheckSuccess：检查成功
CheckFailed：检查失败
Restoring：还原中
Restored：还原成功
RestoreFailed：还原失败

MigrateTaskId.description_en: The ID of the migration task
